question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE order_lines AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_needed
  FROM orderlines 
  WHERE order_id = 423 
  GROUP BY product_id
),
inventory_sorted AS (
  SELECT i.id as inv_id, i.product_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty as avail_qty, p.purchased, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id) as rn
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
  WHERE l.warehouse = 1
    AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines)
),
allocation(inv_id, product_id, aisle, position, avail_qty, needed_remaining, picked, rn) AS (
  SELECT inv.inv_id, inv.product_id, inv.aisle, inv.position, inv.avail_qty, 
         ol.total_needed,
         CASE WHEN inv.avail_qty >= ol.total_needed THEN ol.total_needed ELSE inv.avail_qty END,
         inv.rn
  FROM inventory_sorted inv
  JOIN order_lines ol ON inv.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE inv.rn = 1
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT inv.inv_id, inv.product_id, inv.aisle, inv.position, inv.avail_qty,
         a.needed_remaining - a.picked,
         CASE WHEN (a.needed_remaining - a.picked) >= inv.avail_qty 
              THEN inv.avail_qty 
              ELSE (a.needed_remaining - a.picked) END,
         inv.rn
  FROM allocation a
  JOIN inventory_sorted inv ON inv.product_id = a.product_id AND inv.rn = a.rn + 1
  WHERE a.needed_remaining - a.picked > 0
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, picked as qty_to_pick
FROM allocation
WHERE picked > 0
ORDER BY product_id, rn
